name: Café Rio Seasoned Black Beans Side (High Fiber Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: Café Rio Mexican Grill (Utah County / Salt Lake)
whyItWorks: Whole black beans are rich in insoluble seed coats and galacto-oligosaccharides. These fibers resist small bowel digestion and produce intense fermentation gas, distension, and cramps.
prepOrOrderInstructions: High Fiber & Gas Hazard: Skip beans entirely on bowls, tacos, and burritos. Request extra white rice instead.
